{{Quote|The flames take hold of what once was our friend, our brother, our master--Oppo Rancisis.|[[Darth Krayt|A'Sharad Hett]] eulogizes Oppo Rancisis' funeral|<ref name="Republic 76">[[Republic 76|''Republic'' 76]]</ref>}}
The '''Funeral of Oppo Rancisis''' took place after [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Oppo Rancisis/Legends|Rancisis]] [[Death/Legends|died]] at the hands of his one-time friend, [[Sora Bulq/Legends|Sora Bulq]]. After Bulq was slain by [[Quinlan Vos/Legends|Quinlan Vos]], Vos used his [[Kiffar/Legends|Kiffar]] [[Psychometry/Legends|abilities]] to read memories from Rancisis' body to learn his battle plan.

Before beginning the battle, the surviving [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], led by Vos, remembered their fallen brothers and sisters at the [[Funeral/Legends|funeral]] in a barren area. [[Xeltek]], [[Durnar]], [[Ausar Auset]], [[T'Bolton]], and [[Tholme/Legends|Tholme]] were among the dead; though Tholme's survival was not known at the time.
